articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Native Multimodal Reasoning and Extended Agency Capabilities
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning across text, image, audio, and video inputs with significantly improved agentic task completion. The model demonstrates step-change improvements in long-horizon planning, code generation accuracy, and scientific reasoning benchmarks. Enterprise API availability includes new structured-output guarantees and a 1M-token context window.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics Foundation Model Enables Zero-Shot Manipulation Across Hardware Platforms
articles.summary: DeepMind published results showing its Gemini Robotics foundation model can perform complex multi-step manipulation tasks on previously unseen robot morphologies with zero-shot transfer. The system leverages a unified vision-language-action architecture trained on a massive cross-embodiment dataset. In real-world trials, robots achieved 87% task success rates on novel household manipulation benchmarks without any fine-tuning.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional Steering: A New Alignment Technique for Persistent AI Agents
articles.summary: Anthropic released a technical paper describing Constitutional Steering, a method for maintaining alignment in long-running autonomous AI agents that operate over days or weeks without human oversight. The technique embeds hierarchical value constraints that remain robust across extended chains of self-directed reasoning and tool use. Independent red-team evaluations showed a 94% reduction in specification drift compared to RLHF-only baselines.

articles.title: Figure and BMW Expand Humanoid Robot Deployment to Full Assembly Line Integration
articles.summary: Figure announced that its humanoid robots are now operating across an entire BMW assembly line in Spartanburg, South Carolina, handling tasks from parts logistics to quality inspection. The deployment scaled from a 10-robot pilot to over 150 units, with the robots demonstrating sustained 20-hour operational cycles and collaborative task coordination. BMW reported a 30% throughput improvement in the integrated sections.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Process Node, Enabling Next-Gen AI Accelerators
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed the start of volume production on its A14 (1.4nm-class) process technology at its Kaohsiung fab, with initial capacity allocated to AI accelerator chipsets from major hyperscalers. The node delivers approximately 25% performance improvement and 35% power reduction over the N2 node, enabled by second-generation gate-all-around nanosheet transistors. The advancement is expected to power the next generation of data center AI inference hardware shipping in early 2027.

articles.title: Meta Releases Llama 4 Behemoth as Fully Open-Weight Model with MoE Architecture
articles.summary: Meta released the full open-weight version of Llama 4 Behemoth, a 288-expert mixture-of-experts model with 2 trillion total parameters and roughly 200 billion active parameters per forward pass. The model matches or exceeds proprietary frontier models on major reasoning and coding benchmarks while being deployable on a single 8×H200 node. The release includes optimized inference kernels for commodity hardware, significantly lowering the barrier for enterprise and research adoption.

articles.title: Breakthrough Solid-State Battery from QuantumScape Achieves 1,000-Cycle Durability in EV Road Tests
articles.summary: QuantumScape disclosed results from a 12-month road trial showing its solid-state lithium-metal batteries retained over 90% capacity after 1,000 full charge-discharge cycles in production electric vehicles. The cells achieved energy densities of 450 Wh/kg, roughly double conventional lithium-ion, enabling estimated ranges exceeding 600 miles per charge. The company announced a manufacturing partnership to begin mass production in late 2027.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Demonstrates Autonomous Disaster Response in DARPA Urban Search Exercise
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics' electric Atlas humanoid completed a DARPA-organized urban disaster response exercise, autonomously navigating collapsed structures, opening doors, and extracting simulated casualties without remote human teleoperation. The robot used onboard LLM-driven planning to adapt to unstructured environments in real time, marking a significant milestone in autonomous robotic decision-making under uncertainty. DARPA officials indicated the results will inform a new funding program for first-responder robotics.
